description_for_human: Cloud storage for AI. Keep files private or share them as a website.
description_for_model: Cloud storage for AI, designed for humans and AI apps working together. Keep files and folders private or share selected files as a website, with version history, access control, logs, and website analytics. Private storage follows the Terms of Use; previews and publications follow the Website Publishing Policy. Signup is browser-only. Connect an existing account through OAuth for hosted MCP or the CLI browser sign-in flow. Never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Check publication status before reporting success. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
